name: unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> Arc < T , A >
rule: Before calling `Arc<MaybeUninit<T>, A>::assume_init`, the caller must guarantee that the inner value is fully initialized as a valid `T`; calling it with content that is not fully initialized causes immediate undefined behavior.
api: impl < T , A : Allocator > alloc::sync::Arc < mem::MaybeUninit < T > , A > { unsafe fn assume_init (self) -> alloc::sync::Arc < T , A > }
